hunger_threshold.tooltip: Start eating when the hunger bar drops below this level.
minimap.rotation.tooltip:
North-locked keeps the map static.
Follow camera rotates the map with your view.
minimap.zoom.tooltip:
How many world blocks one map pixel covers.
Higher shows more area with less detail.
hide_vanilla_potion_hud.tooltip:
Removes the vanilla potion effect icons everywhere:
the top-right HUD stack and the panel beside an
open inventory. The custom Potions HUD is not affected.
keep_centered.tooltip:
Keeps container screens centered instead of the vanilla
effect panel occupying the space beside the inventory;
effect icons fall back to the screen corner while open.
compact_item_counts.tooltip:
Renders stack counts of 10,000 and up in the short
1.2k / 3.4m format.
cannontrajectory.power.tooltip:
Initial speed of the predicted TNT along your look direction.
Match this to your cannon's charge to see its true arc.
fire_height.tooltip: How far the fire overlay is pushed down while Low Fire is on, in blocks.
shield_height.tooltip: How far the first-person shield is nudged down while Low Shield is on, in blocks.
pumpkin_opacity.tooltip:
How opaque the carved-pumpkin screen overlay is.
100 is vanilla, 0 hides it.
spyglass_opacity.tooltip:
How opaque the spyglass scope overlay is.
100 is vanilla, 0 hides it.
frost_opacity.tooltip:
How opaque the powder-snow frost overlay is.
100 is vanilla, 0 hides it.
farming.prevent_breaking_bottom_cane.too:
Blocks breaking the bottom block of a sugar cane stalk
while cane still grows above it, so a misclick cannot
destroy the whole plant.
farming.prevent_breaking_bottom_bamboo.t:
Blocks breaking the bottom block of a bamboo stalk
while bamboo still grows above it, so a misclick cannot
destroy the whole plant.
farming.disable_cactus_rendering.tooltip:
Stops placed cactus blocks from rendering.
Cactus items are not affected.
farming.disable_string_rendering.tooltip:
Stops placed tripwire string from rendering.
Huge faction grinders become visible again.
explosionboxes.block_center.tooltip: Snaps every box to the block grid, so the blast cube lines up with the chunks it would break.
explosionboxes.timeout.tooltip: How long a box stays on screen after its TNT or creeper detonates.
explosionboxes.line_thickness.tooltip: Width of the outline drawn around every explosion box.
explosionboxes.creepers.tooltip: Also draws a blast box around creepers (bigger when charged).
imperiumclient.fullscreenmap.title: MAP OF THE REALM
imperiumclient.fullscreenmap.hint: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom (%sx), M to close
emote.tooltip: A built-in id (wave, salute, cheer, sit) or id;Display Name;RRGGBB.
imperiumclient.emotes.title: Emotes
server_hud_safety.tooltip: Only hide the vanilla scoreboard while this HUD actually renders it, so server sidebars never double up or vanish.
blockcoords.dynamic_block_type_color.too: Colors the block name with the block's own map color.
crosshairhud.dynamic_color.tooltip: Recolor the crosshair when aiming at entities or containers.
clear_water.disable_liquid_fov.tooltip:
Removes the field-of-view shrink while your eyes are in water or lava
(needs Clear Water on).
clear_water.overlay_transparency.tooltip:
How opaque the underwater screen overlay is.
10 is vanilla, 0 removes it, 100 is solid.
low_hp_tint.adaptive_opacity.tooltip:
Ramp the tint's strength with your health:
nothing at the threshold, full at 1 hp.
low_hp_tint.min_opacity.tooltip: Floor for the ramped tint strength while Adaptive Opacity is on.
chunk_borders.line_thickness.tooltip:
Width of the chunk border lines.
Region lines are one pixel heavier.
hit_color_on_trims.tooltip: Also flash armour trims with the hit color.
coordshud.display_axis.tooltip: Draws the X/Y/Z prefixes on the coordinate lines.
coordshud.dynamic_biome_color.tooltip: Colors the biome name with a stable per-biome color.
coordshud.middle_click_looking_at.toolti:
Pick-blocking a block puts its name and coordinates
in the chat and the bare coordinates on your clipboard.
potionshud.show_icon.tooltip: Draws the effect icons. Off forces text-only regardless of the display mode.
potionshud.display_vanilla.tooltip:
Keeps the vanilla top-right effect icons drawn
next to this HUD instead of replacing them.
fly_boost_hold: Fly Boost Only While Holding Sprint
fly_boost_hold.tooltip:
On: hold the sprint key for the fly boost.
Off: the boost applies the whole time you fly.
vertical_boost.tooltip: Also applies the fly boost to climbing and sinking while flying.
fly_while_swimming.tooltip: Applies the fly boost to your swim movement while its key condition holds.
armorhud.display_name.tooltip: Draws each item's name beside or under its icon.
armorhud.low_effect.tooltip: Tints items whose remaining durability has dropped to the threshold or below.
armorhud.durability_gradient.tooltip:
Blends the durability readout between the start color (fresh)
and the end color (about to break).
keystrokes.full_space.tooltip: Draws the space bar as a filled bar instead of the thin line.
keystrokes.key_size.tooltip:
Edge length of the default key layout's squares.
Saved custom layouts keep their own sizes.
smooth_scroll.tooltip: Glides the tooltip to its new position instead of jumping.
display_timestamp.tooltip: Adds the elapsed / total time next to the progress bar.
scrolling_track_name.tooltip:
Marquee-scrolls a track name that is wider than the progress bar.
Needs the progress bar on.
smooth_transition.tooltip: Eases the 180-degree snap in and out instead of jumping.
animation_duration.tooltip: How long the smooth snap in and out takes.
